notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
[h1] We are glad to inform you that the development of 'Agony' has been successfully completed. [/h1] 
We have added chapters 12, 13 and the final. The events in the final chapters of this visual novel will depend on your actions in the past and you will come to four absolutely different endings. Later we will publish the information on how to achieve a certain final.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155158/96ea390a20a5dcf9ba8a0fefb988cfdc90cff1f3.jpg[/img]
